header.heading: Families come to Baltimore for care from around the world.
header.lead: At the Rabbi Ephraim & Etti Rubin Tikva House, they find a private place to rest, kosher food that's ready when they are, and other families who understand what they’re going through.

image.alt: The front of the Tikva House, a brick building in warm sunlight, with its door open onto a lit hallway

blocks.heading: What's included
blocks.markdown:
Seven private suites, each with a private bath and kitchenette.

- Stocked kosher pantry
- Shabbos meals
- Communal kitchen & dining area
- Laundry room
- Playroom
- Library
- Wireless internet
- Guest common room

images.alt: A guest suite with a made bed, dark wood floors and a kitchenette
A table set for a Shabbos meal in the guest common room

blocks.intro: Please call the Tikva House at (410) 534-1033. Our team will be glad to discuss further.
